## Summary
- Add `dolphin_cfg.py`: patches/reverts `RetroAchievements.ini`'s `[Achievements]` section (`HostUrl`, `HardcoreEnabled`) on ROCKNIX, mirroring the existing `ppsspp_cfg.py`/`batocera_conf.py` pattern.
- Extend Smart Cache to discover recently played GameCube/Wii games: scans `.gci` memory-card saves and Wii NAND disc-title save folders by mtime, matched against a game-code library built by reading the disc header of `.rvz`/`.wia`/`.iso`/`.gcm` ROM files under Dolphin's configured ISO search paths.
- Wire both into `main.py` (CLI `start-proxy`/`stop-proxy`) and `menu_sdl.py` (the on-device UI's inline start/stop).

## Depends on
This currently has no effect on-device until ROCKNIX ships [ROCKNIX/distribution#3038](https://github.com/ROCKNIX/distribution/pull/3038), since standalone Dolphin's `cheevos_dolphin.sh` fully regenerates `RetroAchievements.ini` on every game launch with no `HostUrl` field — our patch would otherwise be silently wiped before the game session starts. See [misantronic/RAOfflineProxy#33](https://github.com/misantronic/RAOfflineProxy/issues/33) for full context and tracking.

Verified end-to-end (login2 → achievementsets → startsession → awardachievement, all through the local proxy, game cached) using a temporary bind-mount of the patched `cheevos_dolphin.sh` over the real system path — not merged into this PR, that test rig only existed for validation.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3 -m pytest linux/tests/` — 327 passed, 11 skipped (pre-existing, unrelated)
- [x] Verified real end-to-end achievement flow on ROCKNIX hardware via a temporary local test rig (see above)
- [ ] Re-verify without the test rig once ROCKNIX/distribution#3038 merges and ships in a release
items.title: Add Dolphin support for ROCKNIX

items.body:
## What

Replaces the hand-written, per-format ROM hashers (~31 Kotlin files on Android + a 1,256-line Python reimplementation on Linux) with a **single C library built from rcheevos' `rc_hash`** — the same library RetroArch uses to identify games.

- Format coverage: **~20 → 88 systems**
- New formats now come from upstream rcheevos instead of being hand-maintained in two languages
- Net **~3,000 fewer lines** (+2,147 / −5,173)

## How

- **Vendor** `third_party/rcheevos` (gitlink, like `libchdr`) + a small glue layer `third_party/rcheevos_glue`: `rchash_glue` exposes `raproxy_hash_file()` and routes CHD discs through `chd_stream.c` (verbatim from libretro-common) + a trimmed `cdfs_chd.c` over the already-vendored libchdr, mirroring RetroArch's `cheevos.c`. Built with `RC_HASH_NO_ENCRYPTED` (ROM + disc + zip).
- **Android:** one `libraproxy_rchash` (rc_hash + glue + libchdr + JNI), bound via `RcHashNativeBridge`; `RomHashing.kt` is now a thin shim. Per-format strategies, data sources, CHD bridges and the old `chd_jni` are deleted.
- **Linux:** `rom_hashing.py` becomes a ctypes wrapper over `libraproxy_rchash`, built by `linux/build_rchash.sh` and bundled by the muOS/Onion/Knulli scripts.
- **GameCube/Wii containers** (`.rvz`/`.ciso`/`.gcz`/`.wbfs`, raw `.gcm`) — which rc_hash can't decompress — are fed through the revived decompressing `RomDataSource` readers via a JNI data-source-backed filereader (Android only).
- **Arcade/MAME:** rc_hash's arcade hash is `MD5(zip base filename)`, so the zip handler preserves the real filename instead of using a temp copy.

## Verification

- Host: cartridge hash parity (NES/SNES/GB) vs old impl
- Linux ctypes test suite
- **On-device:** Android, muOS and Knulli across cartridge / PSX / PS2 / PSP / CHD / GameCube / Wii / arcade ROMs

## Known limitation

`.nkit.iso` is unsupported (it never was).
items.title: Unify ROM hashing on rcheevos rc_hash
